summary.text: You can use up to $1,130 per day for the first two days, then $400 per day. Surgery limits depend on its complexity.

details.heading: Daily hospital charges
details.body: You can use up to $1,130 per day for the first two days of an inpatient stay. After that, you can use up to $400 per day.

details.heading: Surgery costs
details.body: MediSave can pay part or all of the surgery cost. The amount depends on how complex the surgery is.

details.heading: When you are hospitalised
details.body: You are considered hospitalised if you have been admitted for at least eight hours. This does not apply to day surgeries.

sources.page_title: If I am hospitalised, how much MediSave can I use to pay for my hospitalisation expenses?

quotes.text: For daily hospital charges1, you can use up to $1,130 per day from MediSave for the first two days of inpatient stays, and $400 per day thereafter.

If you had undergone a surgery, you can use your MediSave to cover part of, or the whole surgery cost. The amount of MediSave you can use depends on the complexity of your surgery, as listed in the Table of Surgical Procedures.
It is useful to note that you are considered hospitalised if you have been admitted for at least eight hours. This requirement does not apply to day surgeries.
